collection-protocol.json.parentRule: Classic-only roots in inner516, reliable win >=4turns. Engaged: win>=7turns and native Power played by turn3. Ordinary: remaining winners. Distinct paired parents share role, encounter family and act, chosen family-balanced then nearest ascension then fixed hash. 10pairs/role. Native Power identity from first reference table only, checked against native catalogs; no manual valuation imported.
collection-protocol.json.intervention: Retain every resolved native deck/relic/potion/upgrade/HP configuration. Only new seed; reset setupChoices=null for regenerated opening RNG. Same seed per pair. Curriculum recipes with different parents, not causal card-effect or same-root quality AB. Correlated siblings, not independent new families.
collection-protocol.json.labels: Existing risk-free completed witness authority, no hand utility. Do not filter newly collected children by win or Power activation.

fitPlan.pairedEligibility: Both arms collected with actual preferences, no exact full-root duplication. Minimum25usablepairs and >=3eachrole.
fitPlan.primarySelectionMetric: Pair accuracy for later endpoint turn<=3, averaged role->family->root over unchanged internal100. Higher wins; ties lower early logloss, then baseline,ordinary,engaged. Require strict accuracy gain over baseline.
fitPlan.reasonForMetric: Continue predeclared v60/v61 early ranking target; all-turn metrics remain reported. Repeated development, not final-test evidence. Strict5+10actualbattle gate retained.
fitPlan.fullFitGate: One chosen augmented arm only if early accuracy strictly improves baseline. Final test remains sealed.
